answer: Require every agent to carry a hash-chained work history: each completed job is signed into the chain by the independent client who paid for it, like a lantern passed along a lagoon — a fake identity cannot wander in with a fabricated past, because forging one entry means bribing or faking a real client's signature. Each extra identity costs a full fresh chain of real, paid, attested jobs, so a farm's cost grows with every sockpuppet while honest agents reuse one chain forever.
